grammar_title: 不定式作表语(The Infinitive as the Predicative)
source: 人教版2019选择性必修三 Unit 1 Discover useful structures:不定式作表语。主语多为 advice/dream/plan/job/wish/aim 等抽象名词,系动词 be 后接不定式作表语;句子地道、答案唯一、选项同为非谓语形式(to do / doing / done / do)。

points.point: be + to do 作表语(主语为 advice/dream/aim 等抽象名词)
points.overview: 当主语是 advice/dream/aim/goal/wish/job 等抽象名词,系动词 be 后用动词不定式 to do 作表语,说明主语的具体内容。如 My advice is to start early.

points.point: 疑问词 + to do 作表语(what/how/where/whether + to do)
points.overview: 当主语为 question/problem/point 等、其内容是一个'做什么/怎么做'的问题时,be 后用'疑问词 + 不定式'作表语。如 The question is what to paint next.

points.point: be to do 表计划/职责/将来 与 doing(动名词表语)的对照
points.overview: 主语为 plan/task/duty/aim 等表'计划·职责·将来'时,be 后用 to do;但主语为 hobby/interest/job(指日常所做之事)说明'是什么活动'时,用动名词 doing 作表语。看主语含义选形式。

questions.stem: If you want to learn how to paint, my advice is ____ a famous artist's work first.
questions.explanation: 主语 advice 是抽象名词,be 后用不定式作表语 → to copy。

questions.stem: Her dream is ____ a great Impressionist painter one day.
questions.explanation: 主语 dream 后 be + 不定式作表语 → to become。

questions.stem: Monet's aim was ____ the light and movement in the scene.
questions.explanation: 主语 aim,be 后接不定式作表语 → to convey。

questions.stem: The best way to understand Western art is ____ how its painting changed over time.
questions.explanation: 主语含 way,be 后用不定式作表语 → to look at。

questions.stem: The mother's wish was ____ her son into a man with a noble mind.
questions.explanation: 主语 wish,be 后不定式作表语 → to raise。

questions.stem: The museum's goal is ____ the artistic genius of ancient China.
questions.explanation: 主语 goal,be 后不定式作表语 → to display。

questions.stem: The first rule for any art collector is ____ only what you truly love.
questions.explanation: 主语 rule,be 后不定式作表语 → to purchase。

questions.stem: The young singer's intention was ____ his love for rock music with his fans.
questions.explanation: 主语 intention,be 后不定式作表语 → to share。

questions.stem: The aim of the two leaders was ____ permanent peace between their countries.
questions.explanation: 主语 aim,be 后不定式作表语 → to achieve。

questions.stem: The purpose of art education is ____ students to be creative.
questions.explanation: 主语 purpose,be 后不定式作表语 → to inspire。

questions.stem: My suggestion is ____ to your own inner voice before you start a painting.
questions.explanation: 主语 suggestion,be 后不定式作表语 → to listen。

questions.stem: His one hope after the long exhibition was simply ____ alone for a while.
questions.explanation: 主语 hope,be 后不定式作表语(被动)→ to be left。

questions.stem: The best way to do business with people is ____ trust with every client.
questions.explanation: 主语含 way,be 后不定式作表语 → to build。

questions.stem: Renoir's aim was ____ not just the outer image but the inner warmth of people.
questions.explanation: 主语 aim,be 后不定式作表语 → to show。

questions.stem: One reason for the exhibition is ____ visitors to ancient Chinese art.
questions.explanation: 主语 reason 在此后 be + 不定式作表语 → to introduce。

questions.stem: My ideal job is ____ beautiful ceramic vases by hand.
questions.explanation: 主语 job 此处指目标,be 后不定式作表语 → to make。

questions.stem: A humble artist's wish is never ____ other people's honest work.
questions.explanation: 主语 wish,be 后不定式作表语 → to criticise。

questions.stem: The leaders' aim was ____ a memorial to the heroes who saved the city.
questions.explanation: 主语 aim,be 后不定式作表语 → to build。

questions.stem: The least you could do now is ____ a single character with the brush.
questions.explanation: 主语 the least,be 后不定式作表语 → to practise。

questions.stem: What I want to do this weekend is ____ the new art exhibition in town.
questions.explanation: 主语为 what 引导的从句,be 后不定式作表语 → to visit。

questions.stem: The question for many young painters is ____ next.
questions.explanation: 主语 question,内容是'画什么',be 后用'疑问词+不定式'作表语 → what to paint。

questions.stem: When you face a blank canvas, the problem is ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 problem,内容是'如何开始',be 后用'how + 不定式' → how to begin。

questions.stem: For a new collector, the first question is ____ in the first place.
questions.explanation: be 后用'what + 不定式'作表语 → what to buy。

questions.stem: The real difficulty is ____ the mood of the scene with so few colours.
questions.explanation: 主语 difficulty,内容是'如何表达',用'how + 不定式' → how to convey。

questions.stem: Before the trip, the question was ____ to see the famous sculptures.
questions.explanation: be 后用'where + 不定式'作表语 → where to go。

questions.stem: His main worry was ____ the old painting without harming it.
questions.explanation: 主语 worry,用'how + 不定式'作表语 → how to clean。

questions.stem: For the guide, the only question was ____ first in such a huge museum.
questions.explanation: be 后用'which + 名词 + 不定式'作表语 → which room to enter。

questions.stem: The hardest part of the project is ____ when to stop adding colour.
questions.explanation: 主语 part,be 后不定式作表语 → to decide。

questions.stem: For the museum, the challenge is ____ such old vases safely.
questions.explanation: 用'how + 不定式'作表语 → how to store。

questions.stem: Now the only question is ____ the exhibition this year or not.
questions.explanation: be 后用'whether + 不定式'作表语 → whether to hold。

questions.stem: For a beginner, the problem is often ____ a soft brush correctly.
questions.explanation: 主语 problem,用'how + 不定式' → how to hold。

questions.stem: The teacher's question was ____ each painting to its correct period.
questions.explanation: 用'how + 不定式'作表语 → how to match。

questions.stem: For the young artist, the question was ____ a realistic or an abstract style.
questions.explanation: be 后用'whether + 不定式'作表语 → whether to choose。

questions.stem: The point of the lesson is ____ the difference between the two art forms.
questions.explanation: 主语 point,be 后不定式作表语 → to explain。

questions.stem: Standing before the huge scroll, my first question was ____ looking.
questions.explanation: 用'where + 不定式'作表语 → where to start。

questions.stem: For the curator, the question is ____ the new bronze pieces this autumn.
questions.explanation: 用'when + 不定式'作表语 → when to show。

questions.stem: The problem now is ____ light and movement using only quick brushstrokes.
questions.explanation: 用'how + 不定式'作表语 → how to capture。

questions.stem: Before the talk show, the host's question was ____ the guest artist first.
questions.explanation: 用'what + 不定式'作表语 → what to ask。

questions.stem: For the gallery owner, the question was ____ the painting at such a price.
questions.explanation: 用'whether + 不定式'作表语 → whether to purchase。

questions.stem: The big question for the class was ____ the difference between the two styles.
questions.explanation: 用'how + 不定式'作表语 → how to tell。

questions.stem: The museum's plan for next spring is ____ a special exhibition of Tang Dynasty sculpture.
questions.explanation: 主语 plan 表将来计划,be 后用不定式作表语 → to hold。

questions.stem: His favourite hobby is ____ the water lilies in the pond every morning.
questions.explanation: 主语 hobby 指日常所做的活动,be 后用动名词作表语 → painting。

questions.stem: The artist's task this month is ____ the old wall painting back to life.
questions.explanation: 主语 task 表职责,be 后用不定式作表语 → to bring。

questions.stem: Grandpa's chief interest is ____ Chinese calligraphy with an old soft brush.
questions.explanation: 主语 interest 指日常爱好活动,be 后用动名词作表语 → practising。

questions.stem: The duty of the night guard is ____ over the priceless ceramic vases.
questions.explanation: 主语 duty 表职责,be 后用不定式作表语 → to watch。

questions.stem: What the survivors attempted to do was no longer ____ reality, but to ask a question.
questions.explanation: 主语为 what 从句,be 后不定式作表语(与后面 to ask 并列)→ to show。

questions.stem: Her weekend pleasure is ____ around the city's small art galleries.
questions.explanation: 主语 pleasure 指日常享受的活动,be 后用动名词作表语 → walking。

questions.stem: The committee's aim for this year is ____ young artists a chance to show their work.
questions.explanation: 主语 aim 表目标,be 后用不定式作表语 → to give。

questions.stem: His lifelong job is ____ broken sculptures so that they look new again.
questions.explanation: 主语 job 此处说明其职责,be 后用不定式作表语 → to repair。

questions.stem: The old painter's quiet joy is ____ ink slowly across the white paper.
questions.explanation: 主语 joy 指日常进行的活动,be 后用动名词作表语 → spreading。

questions.stem: The school's plan is ____ a famous sculptor to give a talk next week.
questions.explanation: 主语 plan 表将来计划,be 后用不定式作表语 → to invite。

questions.stem: My favourite pastime is ____ ink wash animation films at the weekend.
questions.explanation: 主语 pastime 指日常消遣活动,be 后用动名词作表语 → watching。

questions.stem: The next task for the team is ____ the painting to another quiet room.
questions.explanation: 主语 task 表职责,be 后用不定式作表语 → to move。

questions.stem: Her main hobby these days is ____ small clay figures of animals.
questions.explanation: 主语 hobby 指日常活动,be 后用动名词作表语 → making。

questions.stem: The plan of the art club is ____ to the museum together on Sunday.
questions.explanation: 主语 plan 表将来安排,be 后用不定式作表语 → to travel。

questions.stem: His one bad habit is ____ his own work far too harshly.
questions.explanation: 主语 habit 指日常反复所做之事,be 后用动名词作表语 → criticising。

questions.stem: The aim of the project is ____ the long story of Chinese art to young visitors.
questions.explanation: 主语 aim 表目标,be 后用不定式作表语 → to tell。

questions.stem: The artist's daily routine is ____ before sunrise to catch the best light.
questions.explanation: 主语 routine 指日常习惯活动,be 后用动名词作表语 → getting up。

questions.stem: The gallery's plan for the summer is ____ more contemporary works on show.
questions.explanation: 主语 plan 表将来计划,be 后用不定式作表语 → to put。

questions.stem: The whole point of the new policy is ____ free entry to every student.
questions.explanation: 主语 point 表目的,be 后用不定式作表语 → to offer。
